text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while I'm out doing some
shopping with
Hishi Akebono...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
So they're selling these cakes nearby
and—

text_block_list.name: Hunched Man
text_block_list.text:
You're blocking the road, brat! Get
outta the
way!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: O-oh! I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A man has suddenly shown up behind
Hishi
Akebono and is screaming at her,
even though
there's plenty of room for
him to walk by.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...But I'm not alone here, and there's no
way I can
risk escalating this and
dragging Hishi Akebono
into some kind
of incident. I restrain myself, and
the
man sneers at us and leaves.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Trainer? You don't have to worry about
me, you
know. I'm totally fine.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for getting all worked up on my
account,
but I like it better when you're
smiling!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: But what if I was in the way? There's nothing wrong with being big and tall, but I should still be careful not to get in the way.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I'll just try to walk at the edge of
the—Oh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We spot the hunched man we just
encountered
bickering with another
student just up the road. I
really can't
stand by this time!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: You're the one getting in everyone's way, ya dunce! Who do you think you are, waltzin' around flailin' your arms all over the place?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Unless you've got the guts to challenge
me to a
one-on-one, scram!

text_block_list.name: Hunched Man
text_block_list.text: Hrk! D-damn you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Patter, patter, patter!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hm, pathetic. He should've kept his
mouth shut if
that's all it takes to send
him runnin' off with his
tail between his
legs.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: That was amazing! She's so cool! And that intensity... I felt like I was watching a sumo wrestler!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Maybe if I try glaring, I can pull off that
intensity
too... There! Am I doing it
right? Do I look scary?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Geez, it sure is hard to look
intimidating!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While heading back home after a day of

shopping...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, look! It's Hishiama and that man
from
before!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I follow her line of sight to see that the
hunched
man has rounded up some
lackeys, and they've
got Hishi Amazon
surrounded.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon is chuckling and cracking
her
knuckles, ready for a brawl, but
nothing good will
come of that. I have to
defuse the situation!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon is chuckling and cracking
her
knuckles, ready for a brawl, but
nothing good will
come of that. I have to
defuse the situation!

text_block_list.name: Hunched Man
text_block_list.text: What? What do you want? Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hmph!

text_block_list.name: Hunched Man
text_block_list.text: Y-you're that brat from before!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: FIGHTING IS WRONG!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The men flinch at the echo of Hishi
Akebono's
booming voice. The hunched
man is so shocked
that he snaps to
attention, his back ramrod
straight.

text_block_list.name: Hunched Man
text_block_list.text:
Eep! Wh-what's with you people?!
Forget this!
Let's get outta here!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And just like that, Hishi Akebono's stern

telling-off sends the men scattering like

cockroaches.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
It's kinda unsatisfying how easy it was to
chase
'em off...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Oh, are you all right, Hishiama?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, thanks for that. That was pretty
badass of
you, Bono.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Really?! Did you hear that, Trainer?
Hehehe! Even
Hishiama thinks I've got it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Afterwards, we report the hunched man
to the
police, and so ends the evening
during which I
got a glimpse at the
typically-calm Hishi
Akebono's more
threatening side.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Oh, Officer! Over here, quick!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono raises her arms and waves
them
wildly in the direction of a nearby
crowd.

text_block_list.name: Police Officer
text_block_list.text: What's the matter?!

text_block_list.name: Hunched Man
text_block_list.text: Crap! We gotta get outta here!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At the sight of the approaching police
officer, the
hunched man panics and lugs
his lackeys away.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I could've taken a couple of punks like
that,
easy... But Fuji would never get off
my case if she
caught me, so thanks for
the help.

text_block_list.name: Police Officer
text_block_list.text:
It's thanks to your waving me down that I

managed to find you all right away. I
appreciate
your fast thinking, good
citizen!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
O-oh, but I barely did anything... Right,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean the officer spotted us
because
I'm so tall? Wow...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ehehe! I guess it is a good thing to be big and tall!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono finally accepts the
officer's thanks
and smiles. We head
back home afterwards with
our heads
held high.
